title: Stage 3: Multi-stage and cache-friendly
summary: Split build from runtime, and order the steps so a code edit rebuilds in seconds.

steps.title: Two fixes in one file
body: COPY TodoApi.csproj .                 # 1. only the project file...
RUN dotnet restore                    #    ...so this layer survives code edits
FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnet:9.0 AS final     # 2. runtime only
rebuild after a       restore +      publish only

steps.prompt: Arrange the build stage so that `dotnet restore` stays cached when only `.cs` files change.
steps.explain: Project file, restore, then the rest of the source, then publish with `--no-restore`.

steps.prompt: You add a NuGet package (which edits `TodoApi.csproj`) and rebuild. What happens?
options: `COPY TodoApi.csproj .` misses, so restore and everything after it run again
The final stage is rebuilt but the build stage is cached
steps.explain: That is the right trade-off: restores happen only when dependencies change.

steps.prompt: A solution has `src/TodoApi/TodoApi.csproj` and `src/Domain/Domain.csproj` (referenced by the API). What must you copy before `dotnet restore`?
options: Both project files (and the .sln or Directory.Packages.props if used), at their relative paths
Nothing: restore downloads project references from NuGet
steps.explain: Restore follows project references, so every referenced .csproj must already be in place.

steps.title: Review the Dockerfile
prompt: Write `List<string> Review(List<string> lines)` returning three lines:
2. `final base: IMAGE` (the image of the last `FROM`)

3. `restore cached on code edits: yes` if the first `RUN` containing `dotnet restore` comes **before** any `COPY` of the whole context (a `COPY` without `--from=` whose sources include `.` or `./`) **in the same stage**; otherwise (including when there is no restore step) `no`.
Instructions may be in any case.
solution: if (keyword == "FROM") { stages++; finalBase = t[1]; copiedAll = false; }
else if (keyword == "RUN" && raw.Contains("dotnet restore") && cached == null) cached = !copiedAll;
return new List<string> { $"stages: {stages}", $"final base: {finalBase}", $"restore cached on code edits: {(cached == true ? "yes" : "no")}" };
template: Dojo.Eq("the good file", new List<string> { "stages: 2", "final base: mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnet:9.0", "restore cached on code edits: yes" }, Review(new List<string> { "FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:9.0 AS build", "WORKDIR /src", "COPY TodoApi.csproj .", "RUN dotnet restore", "COPY . .", "RUN dotnet publish -c Release -o /app/publish --no-restore", "FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnet:9.0 AS final", "WORKDIR /app", "COPY --from=build /app/publish .", "ENTRYPOINT [\"dotnet\", \"TodoApi.dll\"]" }));

Dojo.Eq("the naive file", new List<string> { "stages: 1", "final base: mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:9.0", "restore cached on code edits: no" }, Review(new List<string> { "FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:9.0", "WORKDIR /src", "COPY . .", "RUN dotnet publish -c Release -o /app" }));

Dojo.Eq("restore after COPY . .", new List<string> { "stages: 2", "final base: mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnet:9.0", "restore cached on code edits: no" }, Review(new List<string> { "from mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:9.0 as build", "copy ./ /src", "run dotnet restore", "FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnet:9.0" }));

Dojo.Eq("COPY --from does not count", "restore cached on code edits: yes", Review(new List<string> { "FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:9.0", "COPY --from=tools . /tools", "COPY *.csproj .", "RUN dotnet restore", "COPY . ." })[2]);
